title: Jerry Handoff Protocol v2
description: Schema for structured agent-to-agent handoffs within and across skills. Cross-skill handoffs require source_skill, target_skill, trust_boundary, and data_classification fields. Intra-skill handoffs omit these fields and validate unchanged.

from_agent.description: Identity of sending agent. Must match a registered agent name (kebab-case).

to_agent.description: Identity of receiving agent. Must match a registered agent name (kebab-case).

success_criteria.description: Verifiable criteria for downstream agent. At least one entry required.

artifacts.description: Prior output file paths. Validated for existence before delivery (SV-04, RV-02).

key_findings.description: Orientation bullets from upstream. 3-5 entries per CB-04.

blockers.description: Known impediments. May be empty. Persistent items prefixed with [PERSISTENT] per CP-05.

confidence.description: Sending agent self-assessed confidence. Calibration: 0.0-0.3 low, 0.4-0.6 moderate, 0.7-0.8 high, 0.9-1.0 very high.

criticality.description: Work criticality level. Must not decrease through handoff chains (CP-04).

constraints.description: Optional constraints for the receiving agent.

routing_metadata.description: Optional routing context for circuit breaker and observability.

routing_depth.description: Current routing hop count. Circuit breaker activates at 3 (H-36).

routing_history.description: History of routing hops for cycle detection.

quality_context.description: Optional quality gate context from prior iterations.

task_id.description: Optional worktracker entity ID for traceability.

source_skill.description: Originating skill for cross-skill handoffs. Omit for intra-skill. Accepts any valid skill name (kebab-case prefixed with /).

target_skill.description: Destination skill for cross-skill handoffs. Omit for intra-skill. Accepts any valid skill name (kebab-case prefixed with /).

trust_boundary.description: Trust classification for cross-skill artifact transfer. Required for cross-skill handoffs.

trust_level.description: Three-level trust classification. See Trust Boundary Model.

taint_source.description: Agent or source that originated the tainted content.

taint_propagation.description: Whether downstream handoffs inherit this trust level.

verification_evidence.description: File path to verification report justifying trust_level upgrade. Required when trust_level is analysis-verified or taint_propagation is neutralized. Path MUST resolve to an existing file (RV-02).

verification_method.description: Method used to verify trust upgrade. Required when trust_level is analysis-verified or engineering-context.

verified_by.description: Agent name that performed the verification. Required when trust_level is analysis-verified or engineering-context. MUST differ from taint_source for separation of duties (SV-13).

data_classification.description: Sensitivity classification for the handoff payload. Required for cross-skill handoffs.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol marking per FIRST TLP v2.0.

contains_credentials.description: Whether any artifact may contain credential material. When true, receiving skill MUST apply credential filter pipeline.

engagement_scope_id.description: Reference to the governing engagement scope document.
